summary: Crestline’s calls support a strong first-property foundation: role-based access, Entrata websites, real-time availability, automated late-fee posting, required renewal demographic verification, affordable tax-credit setup, payment-method review, standardized allocation priorities, inspection/checklist templates, and no write-off at financial move-out. Many property-policy choices were demonstrated but never decided, so they remain confirmation questions rather than settings. Because Crestline is still a prospect, migration, accounting, affordable compliance, integrations, reporting, and training needs are listed as functionality rather than treated as completed configuration decisions.

functionality.need: Preserve current month-end controls while simplifying period advancement, locking, bank reconciliation, journal entries, and report packets.

callsUsed.brief: Dallin from Entrata cold-called Jim from Crestline Communities to schedule a demo of Entrata, aiming to potentially replace their long-standing Yardi system. Jim expressed concerns about data migration and maintaining efficiency during a platform transition, while Dallin highlighted Entrata's all-in-one platform and website capabilities. A virtual meeting and lunch were scheduled for next week to address Jim's concerns and showcase Entrata's features.
